answers.core: The shader API information is embedded directly in the core Godot engine code, some of which needs to be modified to access even within Godot's code. It would not be possible to access this information through an add-on.
answers.workaround: Absolutely not. The closest thing that could be done is scraping the documentation, but it would be a massive undertaking given the docs are designed for human-readability. Furthermore, not all operator combinations are documented, and function overloads are vague in regards to what combination of arguments give what return type.
